changes: Routed the ~14 git child-process sites (validate-channel readers, validate-concept diff+repo-grep, cluster-sync git log, worktree story_discard/dev_merge/branchExists/remove helpers) through the existing resolveStorySignedWorkspace() via a new resolveGitCwd helper (authoritativeCwd when resolved, else projectRoot fallback, try/catch). Handler entries (verifier.ts, review-preflight.ts) resolve the gitRoot and thread it down. cwd-only: no git command text, gate semantics, or bootstrap change. Added gitroot-cwd-routing smoke (wrapper-root + plain-repo) wired into npm.
usage: In a wrapper-root project (metadataRoot not a git repo, configured gitRoot=<subdir>), lattice story_discard / validate --channel / validate --concept now run git against the resolved gitRoot and succeed instead of failing with fatal: not a git repository. Plain repos are unchanged (fallback to projectRoot).
expectedOutcome: Wrapper-root: each rerouted git op runs in the resolved gitRoot and succeeds. Plain repo: each op runs in projectRoot, byte-identical. No git command text changed.
actualTranscript: gitroot-cwd-routing smoke: 5/5 pass (wrapper->gitRoot exact cwd, plain->projectRoot, resolver throw->fallback). verify-b-2856: 40/40. validate --story=B-2856 PASS (channel/concept/cluster-sync ran with no fatal). cwd-only diff confirmed (cmdTextChanged=0).
limitations: Scope = Bug 1 only (git cwd). Bugs 2/3/4 (atomic bootstrap; .lattice track/ignore data-loss; lint change-scope) are deferred to separate stories. The out-of-scope bootstrap git add in worktree.ts is left on root (Bug 3).
pitfalls: This is cwd-only — do not change git command text when extending it. worktree TOP-OF-REPO ops use repoRoot (not authoritativeCwd) so they never run from inside the story worktree; worktree-scoped ops still use wtPath. resolveGitCwd must keep the null/throw fallback to projectRoot or plain repos regress.
